topraktan.name: From the Land
topraktan.description: Dishes made with seasonal vegetables and herbs from the land.

denizden.name: From the Sea
denizden.description: Dishes made with seafood from the Aegean and the Mediterranean.

otlaktan.name: From the Pasture
otlaktan.description: Main dishes of carefully cooked meat and offal.

urla-enginar-confit.name: Urla Artichoke Confit
urla-enginar-confit.description: Fresh greens, lacto-fermented fruit and Memecik olive oil.

tuzlu-kavun.name: Salted Melon
tuzlu-kavun.description: Antakya salted yoghurt, melon slices, white roasted chickpeas and Memecik olive oil.

uc-mantarli-taze-cavatelli.name: Fresh Three-Mushroom Cavatelli
uc-mantarli-taze-cavatelli.description: Porcini, chanterelle and oyster mushrooms with aged Mihaliç sheep’s cheese.

kereviz-sinitzel.name: Celeriac Schnitzel
kereviz-sinitzel.description: Breaded celeriac slices, hibeş (Antalya-style tahini dip) and finely chopped spoon salad.

ci-salatasi.name: “Çi” Salad
ci-salatasi.description: Rocket, wild purslane, Yedikule lettuce, seasonal fruit, Çorum Kargı tulum cheese, roasted walnuts and cucumber vinaigrette.

avokadolu-fume-somon-tartar.name: Smoked Salmon Tartare with Avocado
avokadolu-fume-somon-tartar.description: With caper berries and crisp toasts.

karisik-kabuklu-kasesi.name: Mixed Shellfish Bowl
karisik-kabuklu-kasesi.description: Vongole, kidonya clams, black mussels, razor clams and scallops, in a tomato or white wine sauce.

ci-karides.name: “Çi” Prawns
ci-karides.description: Afyon sourdough bread and bottarga butter.

izgara-baby-kalamar.name: Grilled Baby Squid
izgara-baby-kalamar.description: Tomato compote and aged Mihaliç cheese.

aslan-baligi.name: Lionfish
aslan-baligi.description: Basil and green apple beurre blanc.

izgara-granyoz.name: Grilled Meagre
izgara-granyoz.description: Buckwheat and cucumber salad with a brown butter caper sauce.

deniz-mahsullu-makarna.name: Seafood Pasta
deniz-mahsullu-makarna.description: San Marzano tomato sauce, prawns, squid, shelled mussels, vongole and Divle Obruk cave-aged cheese.

sakatat-pate.name: Offal Pâté
sakatat-pate.description: Lamb sweetbreads, lamb brains, chicken liver and chicken hearts.

arnavut-cigeri.name: Albanian-Style Liver
arnavut-cigeri.description: Onion salad and crisp hand-rolled yufka flatbread.

izgara-kuzu-kokorec.name: Grilled Lamb Kokoreç
izgara-kuzu-kokorec.description: Lamb intestines with Denizli kale peppers, Antakya salted yoghurt and matchstick cucumber salad.

izgara-dana-kontrfile-dilimleri.name: Grilled Sliced Beef Sirloin
izgara-dana-kontrfile-dilimleri.description: Courgette polenta and caramelised onion sauce.
